# Appliances 2 U (A2U)

> Appliances 2 U Ltd is an independent home appliance store at 203 Strand Road, Bootle, Liverpool L20 3HJ, United Kingdom. It sells new and graded (ex-display / cosmetically marked) washing machines, tumble dryers, fridge freezers, cookers and integrated appliances from brands including Samsung, Bosch, Beko, Hotpoint, Hoover, Candy, at prices below the high street. Local delivery, installation and old appliance removal available. Rated 5.0/5 from 33 Google reviews. Phone 07769 865432 or 07752 241831. Open Monday to Saturday, 10am – 4:30pm.

## Key facts
- Address: 203 Strand Road, Bootle, Liverpool L20 3HJ
- Phone: 07769 865432 or 07752 241831
- Opening hours:
  - Monday – Saturday: 10am – 4:30pm
  - Sunday: Closed
- Payment: Visa, Mastercard
- Delivery: Local delivery, installation and old appliance removal available across Bootle, Liverpool and nearby areas. Ask for a price when you call.
- Delivery areas: Bootle, Litherland, Seaforth, Orrell, Netherton, Kirkdale, Walton, Waterloo, Crosby, Aintree, Everton, Anfield, Liverpool city centre
- Stock changes weekly; customers should call to check availability and prices.
